attributes.title: Level 4

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using animations and music in your code to enhance the player experience!

questions.title: [Select one] Animations…

answers.text: Make the game feel more immersive.
Help drive storytelling in a game.

questions.correctResponse: Animations contribute to a huge part of the player experience!

questions.hint: Tempo is usually measured in Beats Per Minute.
questions.title: [Select one] Tempo changes how fast a piece of music plays.
questions.correctResponse: Tempo is usually measured in Beats Per Minute. A fast-feeling melody will have a larger value for Tempo.

questions.hint: What tempo pace signals low energy? What tempo pace signals high energy?
questions.title: [Match one per answer] Match the music and tempo to the feeling.
questions.correctResponse: Tempo, volume and more can change what kind of emotion or atmosphere a piece of music creates!

subgroups.title: Animations and Music!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using animations and music in your code to enhance the player experience!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of Yellow Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about using animation and music to make your projects even more awesome! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: The Ol’ Razzle Dazzle
badges.description: Use animation and music to enhance a project.

badges.title: Saturday Morning Cartoons
badges.description: Use both image and movement animation in a project.

badges.title: On and On and On and...
badges.description: Repeat a melody or sound on loop in the background of a project.

badges.title: Original Score
badges.description: Compose a custom melody in MakeCode.
